title: entities block, schema 2: roster groups, attribute fields, avatars
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §6 (K-R40..K-R44). Core entity fields (id, name, node, source) and the multi-source priority are fixed by the kernel and not written here. The pack names its groups (where the rows come from) and its attribute fields (how a value is shown). Absent block = every entity shows name and place only; groups are discovered from the card's name-keyed tables.

row.description: A pack-supplied row: shown until a live source has the same person.

values.description: field name -> value, same field names as fields[].field.

source.description: Live source (K-R41): mvu = dot path of a table in stat_data, keyed by name or an array of rows; name = the row field holding the name (array tables); place = the row field holding the place text; with = a row field whose yes-value puts that person with the player; present = everyone in this table is with the player; tags = the chat's character tags. Absent = pack rows only. name and place default to discovery by the kernel's field vocabulary.

up_to.description: gauge bands: the band covers values up to this number (inclusive).

match.description: ladder steps: texts that mean this step (default: the label).

field.description: Key in the source row, verbatim from the card.

kind.description: text = free text; tag = short chip (text, number or yes/no); gauge = number 0..max drawn as a meter, ladder = its named bands; ladder = ordered steps low to high, the value is matched to a step.

max.description: gauge only, greater than min. Default 100.

scan.description: ladder only: when the field is missing, look for a step in the row's other text values. Default false.

show.description: Where it appears. Default: text -> detail, others -> chip.

avatar.description: Where portraits may come from. Kernel rules stay: https only, image file types, no query string, and the user's own switch can turn all remote portraits off.

from.description: Default [imagegen]: only the optional image extension's library.

hosts.description: Allowed host[/path-prefix] for card-script portraits: the host has a dot and must equal the URL host; a path prefix ends at a / (K-R43).

deny.description: Path fragments never loaded, even from an allowed host.

storage.description: card-storage: localStorage keys the card's own UI writes (read only). Keys may not start with the kernel's reserved prefixes (K-R43).
